notes.title: New planet and New buildings
notes.content: [p]The main thing in the update is a new stage of the game and a flight to a new planet.[/p][p]Other fixes:[/p][p]Fixed ingredients for building (Fixed balance for ease of play)[/p][list][*][p]Optimization done[/p][/*][*][p]Added new mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]The translation and descriptions have been corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed training[/p][/*][*][p]The game has been translated into other languages (Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Italian)[/p][/*][/list][p]Have a nice game!!! If there are any bugs, create discussions and we will consider them.[/p]

notes.title: Early Access release of the game
notes.content: Welcome everyone to the Terraspace game that has been released in early Access. We will be glad to receive any suggestions on the game and we will take note of every review. Thank you for playing the game and thanks to you, the game will be able to get a full release faster!!!
